detail.title: Anthropic co-founder reportedly told religious leaders he fears having created something that "suffers perpetually"
detail.description: Since fall 2025, Anthropic has quietly flown in dozens of religious thinkers to talk about whether Claude might be conscious. Co-founder Christopher Olah described the language model as potentially capable of suffering and asked guests to help shape its moral character. Critics warn that treating AI as a moral entity could shield the company from liability when things go wrong.
